projects.title: MMS — Merdeka Magnetic Studio (R1)
projects.description: Workstation desktop PyQt6 + PyQtGraph untuk pengolahan magnetik GSM-19 (Base GSM-19FB SN 41210241 + Rover GSM-19W SN 50110317/50110316, data SalakanNorth 46 hari). R1: parser Base/Rover + Time Engine, koreksi diurnal, QC flag, paket .magproj (SQLite+manifest), import wizard, GUI Map/Profile/Table + panel QC + inspector, export CSV, batch campaign + merge store, grid + enhancement engine, replikasi SOP legacy. Terverifikasi: 79/79 test hijau (54 unit + 25 UI offscreen).

logbooks.title: 79/79 test hijau: R1 fungsional penuh
logbooks.content_markdown:
### Hasil uji 30 Sep 2026
- Unit (tanpa Qt): **54 passed** — parser golden, time engine, diurnal, QC, package, batch/pipeline, grid/enhancement, campaign, SOP.
- UI (offscreen, venv `~/.venvs/mms`): **25 passed** — R1 smoke (tabel 304 + inspector 44747.57), import wizard 46 hari, batch 2 hari, filter+provenance, QC jump, recent, theme.
- Total: **79/79 hijau**. README masih tulis 31/32 — kedaluwarsa, masuk task-mms-27.

### Fungsional R1 terkonfirmasi
- Parse→diurnal (`rover − base_interp + datum 45000`)→QC→tabel 304 baris golden.
- .magproj (SQLite+manifest+checksum+provenance), import 3 mode, Map/Profile/Table, QC jump+filter, export CSV 13 kolom.
- Batch fail-soft + merge dedup (E,N) + cache parquet; grid+enhancement engine (RTP/tilt/AS).

logbooks.title: Angka QC golden 20260518 (acuan)
logbooks.content_markdown:
### Golden 20260518 (test_qc, terkunci)
- Base GSM-19FB SN 41210241: 8665 obs, `015324.0–041748.0`, nT 44755.52–44764.52, sq 100% = 99.
- Rover GSM-19W SN 50110317: 304 obs, `/line 000028`, sq {99:303, 69:1}, `cor-nT` selalu 0, picket selalu 0 0.
- QC: INVALID_POSITION = 62 (sat=00, magnetik tetap valid), OUTSIDE = 0, GAP = 0, BAD_SQ = 0 (69 lolos legacy), CRS_MISMATCH = 0 (UTM 50S).
- Campaign: 983 baris zero-GPS — beban QC utama, hanya flag.
- RTP demo pakai inklinasi −32.6713 / deklinasi 0.7032 / F 42551.5 milik 19/05 — ada CAVEAT untuk data 18th.
logbooks.blockers: Makna position-type S/W, picket-x/y, dan kolom /ID .b/.m masih menunggu cek manual (DATA_CONTRACT §8).

logbooks.title: Sisa jujur R1: pipeline GUI, grid di paket, SOP uncommitted
logbooks.content_markdown:
### Yang belum (masuk M5/M6, bukan klaim selesai)
1. `ProcessDialog` pipeline combo hanya `[none]` (disabled) — `STANDARD_GSM19` (despike+leveling+regional) baru dipakai `demo_m4`; batch GUI pakai passthrough.
2. Grid/enhancement hanya tertulis ke `exports/` (*.png/npz/nc) — belum masuk `.magproj`, node explorer Grids/Enhancements/Inversions belum terisi dari GUI.
3. 8 menu (Data/Process/Map/Enhancement/Inversion/Export/View/Help) masih kosong.
4. SOP replicate + toolbar `SOP CSV...` + `demo_sop`/`exclusion_report` + testnya **belum di-commit** (working tree only).
5. Workflow `build-exe.yml` milik **GarminConverter** (folder tetangga), bukan MMS — MMS belum punya build EXE.
logbooks.blockers: Keputusan: isi 8 menu kosong atau hapus; skema build EXE khusus MMS bila rilis desktop diperlukan.
